=== Original heirship review — 30 October 2026 ===
The existing father [[Glascow-14|Isaac Glasgow]] is now assessed at '''96% confident inference''', superseding the earlier 63% grade. The original 1851 Weakley deed calls its grantors the heirs of deceased Isaac Glasgow and conveys land originally surveyed in his name. The acknowledgment expands J.G. to John G.; this matches the specific inherited family group. Green is the existing profile expansion, not spelled out here. Numerous other heirs match Isaac’s existing family, including Elijah, William C., Wagstaff K., John G., Joseph D. and Jesse Glasgow, with the Adams couple. This supports confident fatherhood by the combined specific family group, rather than a generic same-name or age match.<ref name="WeakleyHeirs1851">[https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSKJ-RS12-5 Weakley County Register of Deeds, pp. 410–411], DGS 008151469, image 213; deed 20 February 1851, acknowledgment 14 March, registered 15 March. Original inspected 30 October 2026.</ref>
